_schema.price_status: verified = the price was read directly from the provider's public pricing page on verified_on. unverified = specs are confirmed but the price could not be read (JS-rendered or region-gated) and must be filled in by a human before it is allowed into a published calculation.
_schema.policy: Only plans with price_status = verified and a non-null price_usd_month are allowed to feed a published TCO figure. Everything else renders as a spec-only listing. scripts/check_staleness.py enforces the review window.
_schema.extra_storage: extra_storage_usd_gb_month is the published price of block storage added to a server, per GB per month. When a tool needs more disk than any affordable plan includes, the cheapest option is often a small server plus a volume, and the model prices that.

providers.name: DigitalOcean
providers.billing_note: Per-second billing since 1 January 2026, with a minimum charge of 60 seconds or $0.01. Monthly caps still apply.
weaknesses: Roughly 2-3x the price of European budget hosts for the same RAM
providers.extra_storage_note: Volumes block storage: 100 GiB for $10, 500 GiB for $50, 1,000 GiB for $100, read on 2026-10-09 from the Volumes pricing page. Volume snapshots cost $0.06 per GiB a month and are not included here.

providers.name: Hetzner Cloud
providers.billing_note: Hourly billing capped at the monthly price shown. Prices are quoted in euros excluding VAT and converted once at the dated rate on the methodology page. Every plan includes 20 TB of traffic.
strengths: The cheapest memory of any provider we have priced: 8 GB for EUR 8.99 a month on the Cost-Optimized line
20 TB of traffic included on every plan
German company with European data centres, which settles most data-residency questions
weaknesses: Hetzner sells the Cost-Optimized line for test and development environments, with variable CPU performance, so the cheapest rows here are not a like-for-like swap for a dedicated-thread server
Prices exclude VAT and are quoted in euros, so a non-European buyer carries the exchange-rate risk
No block storage price is recorded here yet, so storage-heavy tools do not pick Hetzner
providers.price_note: Read on 2026-10-25 from the Regular Performance and Cost-Optimized pages. Two earlier attempts failed: the figures are injected by a web component and each row carries a hidden 'currently unavailable' tooltip that reads as if the plan could not be ordered. Both lines are orderable, and the prices below are the lowest shown, which apply to the German, Finnish and Singapore locations; other locations cost more.

providers.name: Kamatera
providers.billing_note: Fixed monthly plans, billed by the minute. The pricing page lists extra traffic at $0.01 per GB and extra storage at $0.05 per GB per month; neither is included in the figures on this site.
strengths: Its 1 GB plan ties with VPSServer as the cheapest 1 GB server among the providers we have priced
The fixed plans run on dedicated CPU threads, according to the pricing page
Billed by the minute, which suits short trials
weaknesses: Every fixed plan includes only 20 GB of disk, so most multi-container tools need paid extra storage
Above 1 GB of memory, the fixed plans cost more than DigitalOcean for the same RAM
providers.price_note: Read from the three fixed plans on the Kamatera pricing page on 2026-09-14. Kamatera also sells custom configurations through a calculator whose per-component prices were not shown, so only the fixed plans are used here.
providers.extra_storage_note: The pricing page states additional storage is $0.05 per GB a month, read on 2026-10-09.

providers.name: Vultr
providers.billing_note: Hourly billing with a monthly cap. 32 global regions.
strengths: Widest region coverage of the budget hosts
weaknesses: Support is community-first on lower tiers
providers.price_note: The pricing table sits behind a consent gate and lazy rendering, so no plan could be read on 2026-09-12.

providers.name: PikaPods
providers.billing_note: Pay-per-resource managed hosting of open-source apps. No server administration.
strengths: No sysadmin work at all, which removes the labour line entirely
Per-app pricing suits a single tool
Cheapest honest option below roughly 10 users
weaknesses: App catalogue is curated, not arbitrary
Costs scale per app rather than per server
providers.price_note: Its resource-based pricing could not be read programmatically.

providers.name: VPSServer
providers.billing_note: Configurable servers billed monthly, or by the minute on hourly plans. 1 to 5 TB of traffic a month is included depending on location, and extra traffic is $0.01 per GB. Prices exclude VAT.
strengths: The lowest price per gigabyte of memory among the providers we have priced, at every size from 2 GB up
Memory, processors and disk are chosen separately, so a disk-hungry tool does not force a bigger plan
Billed by the minute on hourly plans, which suits short trials
weaknesses: The Starter (Type A) servers priced here are described by VPSServer as meant for always-on tasks rather than high-speed performance; its Standard and Enterprise types cost more
Its own terms place it in the same corporate group as Kamatera, so the two are not independent suppliers
providers.price_note: Read on 2026-09-21 from the configurator on the VPSServer pricing page: Starter (Type A) servers running Ubuntu Server, on monthly billing. The configurator sets memory, processors and disk separately; the plans listed here are the combinations we priced.
providers.extra_storage_note: The configurator prices NVMe disk at about $0.10 per GB a month: with 4 GB of memory, 80 GB costs $22 a month, 500 GB costs $60 and 1,000 GB costs $110, read on 2026-10-09.
